name: search_contacts
description: Find contacts by email (matched case- and space-insensitively), by name or by account; returns ids and consent status.

name: get_contact
description: A contact's record: account, title, country, consent status and their leads.

name: search_accounts
description: Find companies by name or email domain.

name: get_account
description: A company's record with its contacts and leads; only facts the company gave are recorded.

name: get_lead
description: A lead: the rubric facts on file, status, owner or queue, notes and demos.

name: list_open_leads
description: Open leads, filtered by contact, account or owner.

name: get_icp_rules
description: The qualification rubric: its fields, which are required and what qualifies.

name: get_routing_rules
description: Territory owners by country and the fallback queue for unmapped countries; with country, the owner that applies.

name: upsert_lead
description: Record an inbound request: reuses the contact for a known email and updates their open lead instead of creating duplicates; creates contact and lead only for a new person, with only the facts the prospect gave.

name.description: Person's name, for a new contact

company.description: Company name as the prospect gave it, for a new company

request_key.description: Idempotency key; reuse it on a retry

name: qualify_lead
description: Evaluate a lead against the rubric with facts the prospect stated (rubric fields only): qualified, disqualified, or needs_information with the missing fields.

facts.description: Rubric fields stated by the prospect: seats, use_case, timeline, country, budget

name: assign_owner
description: Route a qualified lead: to the rep who owns its country, or to the fallback queue when no rep does. Give rep_id or queue_id.

name: add_lead_note
description: Add a note to a lead.

name: update_contact_consent
description: Record a contact's consent: an opt-out stops every planned follow-up and keeps the audit record. Needs confirmed=true.

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. chat, email, prospect_request

confirmed.description: The person agreed to the change as read back

name: get_owner_availability
description: A rep's busy times from their calendar, with their time zone.

name: list_demo_slots
description: Open demo slots on a rep's calendar (or the lead owner's), free of calendar conflicts.

lead_id.description: Lead id, to use its owner

name: book_demo
description: Book the slot the prospect chose on the lead owner's calendar: writes the demo and the calendar event together. Needs prospect_confirmed=true.

name: cancel_demo
description: Cancel a booked demo and its calendar event; the slot opens again. Needs confirmed=true.

name: create_handoff
description: Open a handoff for a lead: to its owner (rep_handoff, qualified leads only), a specialist, or a follow-up (refused after an opt-out).

summary.description: Facts from the records and the conversation only

name: search_threads
description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail search query (label:ID, is:unread, in:inbox, from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:7d, free terms). Full message bodies are not returned; use get_thread for them. Drafts, spam and trash are excluded.

name: get_thread
description: Retrieves an email thread by ID with its messages in date order (bodies under FULL_CONTENT).

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: get_message
description: Retrieves one email message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: list_labels
description: Lists the user-defined labels of the mailbox with their IDs. System label IDs (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH) are usable without listing.

name: label_thread
description: Adds labels to an entire thread (every message in it). Takes label IDs, not names; use list_labels when unsure of a user label's ID.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: unlabel_thread
description: Removes labels from an entire thread. Takes label IDs, not names.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: list_drafts
description: Lists the mailbox's drafts, newest first. humanEdited marks a draft a person has edited.

name: create_draft
description: Creates a draft email for a person to review and send. To reply in an existing thread pass the original message's ID as replyToMessageId. Addresses are plain (no 'Name <email>'). Attachments are not supported yet. Nothing is sent.

replyToMessageId.description: The message this draft replies to; the draft joins its thread.

name: list_calendars
description: The calendars the user has access to, with their IDs; resolves a calendar name to its calendar_id. accessRole says what the user may do on each.

pageSize.description: Max results per page. Default 100, max 250.

name: list_events
description: Events on a calendar matching the constraints. Set startTime and endTime only when a specific timeframe is requested. For open-ended keyword searches on the primary calendar use search_events.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

pageSize.description: Max events per page (default 100, max 250). Recommended: 10.

startTime.description: Start of the timeframe (ISO 8601, for example '2026-04-30T10:00:00Z').

endTime.description: End of the timeframe (ISO 8601, for example '2026-04-30T10:00:00Z').

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

fullText.description: Free-form search over title, description, location and attendees (all terms must match).

name: get_event
description: A single event on a calendar.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

name: search_events
description: Searches events on the user's primary calendar by keywords (case-insensitive).

query.description: Query string to search for events.

name: suggest_time
description: Suggests free time slots across the attendees' calendars within a query interval, respecting the configured buffer between events. A suggestion reserves nothing: create the event after the user confirms.

attendeeEmails.description: Attendee emails to find free time for.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

name: create_event
description: Creates an event on a calendar. Attendees must be reachable within the attendee domain policy; conflicts with confirmed events are refused. Needs the user's approval of this exact event (approval_id).

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

name: update_event
description: Updates an event; fields that are not set are not changed. Moving only the start preserves the duration. Needs approval_id, and expected_version must match the event's current version.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to update.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

expected_version.description: The event version the change was decided on; a stale version is refused.

name: delete_event
description: Cancels an event. For a recurring event, recurring_action says whether this occurrence (default) or the whole series is cancelled. Needs approval_id.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to delete.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

name: slack_search_channels
description: Search for Slack channels by name or topic. Returns channel IDs, names, topics, privacy and membership. Private channels appear only to their members.

keywords.description: Lexical terms that must appear in the channel's name or topic; single words or quoted phrases, all AND'd.

natural_language_query.description: The user's question in conversational tone.

name: slack_read_channel
description: Reads messages from a channel, newest first. Read-only. Use slack_read_thread with a message's ts to read its replies; use slack_search_channels to find a channel ID.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to fetch history for.

name: slack_read_thread
description: Reads a thread: the parent message and its replies, oldest first. Read-only. message_ts is the parent message's ts.

message_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message, e.g. "1234567890.123456".

name: slack_search_public_and_private
description: Searches messages in all channels the acting user can access. keywords are lexical terms (all AND'd); filters are Slack search modifiers: in:<#C123>, from:<@U123>, after:YYYY-MM-DD, before:YYYY-MM-DD. Give at least one of keywords or filters.

after.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp.

before.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp.

name: slack_send_message
description: Sends a message to a channel, or a thread reply with thread_ts. Posting is approval-gated: approval_id must name an approval of this exact destination and text for the acting user. request_key makes a retry return the message already posted instead of a duplicate. No @channel, @here or @everyone.

thread_ts.description: Parent message ts to reply in its thread.

name: slack_check_message_status
description: Check delivery status and idempotency ledger record for a given request_key.

request_key.description: The idempotency request key to inspect.
